_comment: agent-fabric ADR-067: each cross-cutting mechanism has one owning module, and every other module uses it. One entry per mechanism: the record it comes from, its owner, and its status. enforced: its checker and exceptions file are tracked, and a lint rule lint.py runs, the pre-commit hook and a tests/ case load the checker. pending: the job building the checker, as <login>/j<n>; the checker's paths enter with enforcement. planned: what it waits on; its owner is named once built. Every path named is tracked. tools/fabric/lint_rules/mechanisms.py reads this file.

message-transport.waits_on: W1-A landed: a transport interface over the relay and InterWeave carriers as its owner, the relay staying primary (ADR-064)
